	else_if = { limit = { terrain = terraced_hills } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|terrain|terraced_hills" }
	else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|L|terrain|unknown" }
	# winter severity: the engine swaps these province modifiers as the winter changes
	if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = winter_harsh_modifier } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|winter|harsh" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = winter_normal_modifier } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|winter|normal" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = winter_mild_modifier } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|winter|mild" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_province_modifier = winter_none_modifier } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|winter|none" }
	else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|L|winter|none" }
	# holding (common/holdings)
	if = { limit = { has_holding = no } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|holding|none" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_holding_type = castle_holding } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|holding|castle_holding" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_holding_type = church_holding } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|holding|church_holding" }

	else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|L|holding|other" }
	if = { limit = { is_coastal = yes } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|coastal|yes" }
	else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|L|coastal|no" }
	if = { limit = { is_riverside_province = yes } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|riverside|yes" }
	else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|L|riverside|no" }
	if = { limit = { any_army_in_location = { is_army_in_siege = yes } } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|siege|yes" }
	else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|L|siege|no" }
	if = { limit = { OR = { is_raided = yes any_army_in_location = { is_army_in_combat = yes is_raid_army = yes } } } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|raid|yes" }
	else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|L|raid|no" }

	else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|L|occupied|no" }

	else_if = { limit = { geographical_region = world_asia_khitan_steppe } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|region|world_asia_khitan_steppe" }
	else_if = { limit = { geographical_region = world_middle_east } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|region|world_middle_east" }
	else_if = { limit = { geographical_region = world_africa_north } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|region|world_africa_north" }
	else_if = { limit = { geographical_region = world_africa_sahara } info_log = "CK3XBL|L|region|world_africa_sahara" }

		limit = { exists = culture }
		culture = { ck3xbl_emit_l_culture_effect = yes }
	}
	else = {
		info_log = "CK3XBL|L|building_gfx|none"
		info_log = "CK3XBL|L|loc_culture|none"
		info_log = "CK3XBL|L|loc_heritage|none"

	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_l_fort value = fort_level }

	else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|L|loc_heritage|unknown" }
}

# this = culture of an army owner (AX lines follow that army's A record)
ck3xbl_emit_ax_culture_effect = {
	# culture
	if = { limit = { this = culture:acehnese } info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|culture|acehnese" }
	else_if = { limit = { this = culture:afar } info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|culture|afar" }
	else_if = { limit = { this = culture:afghan } info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|culture|afghan" }

	else_if = { limit = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_tibetan } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|heritage|heritage_tibetan" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_tocharian } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|heritage|heritage_tocharian" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_tungusic } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|heritage|heritage_tungusic" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_turkic } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|heritage|heritage_turkic" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_ugro_permian } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|heritage|heritage_ugro_permian" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_viet } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|heritage|heritage_viet" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_vlach } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|heritage|heritage_vlach" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_volga_finnic } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|heritage|heritage_volga_finnic" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_west_african } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|heritage|heritage_west_african" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_west_germanic } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|heritage|heritage_west_germanic" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_west_slavic } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|heritage|heritage_west_slavic" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_yoruba } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|heritage|heritage_yoruba" }
	else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|heritage|unknown" }
	# unit_gfx
	if = { limit = { has_unit_gfx = chinese_unit_gfx } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|unit_gfx|chinese_unit_gfx" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_unit_gfx = eastern_unit_gfx } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|unit_gfx|eastern_unit_gfx" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_unit_gfx = emishi_unit_gfx } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|unit_gfx|emishi_unit_gfx" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_unit_gfx = iberian_christian_unit_gfx } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|unit_gfx|iberian_christian_unit_gfx" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_unit_gfx = iberian_muslim_unit_gfx } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|unit_gfx|iberian_muslim_unit_gfx" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_unit_gfx = southeast_asian_unit_gfx } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|unit_gfx|southeast_asian_unit_gfx" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_unit_gfx = indian_unit_gfx } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|unit_gfx|indian_unit_gfx" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_unit_gfx = iranian_unit_gfx } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|unit_gfx|iranian_unit_gfx" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_unit_gfx = japanese_unit_gfx } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|unit_gfx|japanese_unit_gfx" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_unit_gfx = mena_unit_gfx } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|unit_gfx|mena_unit_gfx" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_unit_gfx = mongol_unit_gfx } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|unit_gfx|mongol_unit_gfx" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_unit_gfx = norse_unit_gfx } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|unit_gfx|norse_unit_gfx" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_unit_gfx = northern_unit_gfx } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|unit_gfx|northern_unit_gfx" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_unit_gfx = sub_sahran_unit_gfx } info_log = "CK3XBL|RX|unit_gfx|sub_sahran_unit_gfx" }

# this = character. has_ethnicity has no vanilla use; keys are the CK3 ethnicity database entries.

	if = { limit = { has_ethnicity = african } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|ethnicity|african" }
